resources.string: ML-DSA signs data with a private key, and anyone with the public key can check it. Like ML-KEM it is built on lattices, so a quantum computer cannot forge it the way it could forge RSA or ECDSA.

resources.string: A label that binds the signature to one purpose. A signature made for payments will not pass as a login.
The FIPS 204 default. Fresh randomness goes into every signature, which also protects against fault attacks.
No randomness, for devices without a good random source. The same message always gives the same signature.

Invalid: the message, the context or the signature changed
